create_adsorbate_from_atoms: create an Adsorbate object from an ase.Atoms structure with specified binding atom indices
create_adsorbate_from_db_id: create an Adsorbate object by selecting it from the adsorbate database using its integer ID
create_adsorbate_from_smiles: create an Adsorbate object by looking up its SMILES string in the adsorbate database
sample_adsorbate_randomly: sample a random Adsorbate from the adsorbate database and load its atoms and binding indices
rotate_adsorbate: rotate an adsorbate using random, heuristic, or random_site_heuristic_placement mode with optional binding index
